project: JSH GLOBAL - Single-Page Catalogue & Nano Banana Product Imagery

userStories.title: Backend pagination limit relaxation
userStories.description: Allow API to serve all products on page 1 without being clamped to 50.
acceptanceCriteria: getPagination maxLimit increased from 50 to 250 in server/src/utils/pagination.js
getProductsQuerySchema limit validation allows up to 250 in server/src/modules/product/product.validation.js
API returns all 115 active commodities in a single request when limit is 200

userStories.title: Single-page product catalogue and pagination removal
userStories.description: Show all products on one page without Next/Previous buttons unless a filter is applied.
acceptanceCriteria: When no filter or category is selected, client requests all products (limit: 200) on page 1
Next and Previous pagination buttons are completely removed/hidden when no filter or category is active
When category or search filter is applied, normal filtered pagination behavior is maintained
Total product count display remains accurate and responsive

userStories.title: Nano Banana product imagery generation and pipeline integration
userStories.description: Generate professional studio product photography for un-imaged commodities using Nano Banana.
acceptanceCriteria: Graphic designer prompts crafted following studio travertine and ceramic aesthetic
High-demand commodities without images identified from normalized catalog
Generated images processed with sharp into 800x600 WebP and multi-width formats
PostgreSQL product records synchronized with new image payloads

userStories.title: Verification, visual evidence and report
userStories.description: Verify all changes across unit tests, production build, and Playwright visual screenshots.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run lint passes with 0 errors
Playwright visual screenshots capture full single-page catalogue without Next/Previous buttons
